beats.direction: Use the recurring witness with an on-screen disclaimer: CITY CONTEXT / NOT DAY-SPECIFIC.
beats.voice: Copenhagen turns participation into an evidence problem: admission, time, teardown, rights, screening, product data and institutional memory each demand a record. This chapter follows circulation: A public stream can widen technical access while ranking systems, language, bandwidth and platform ownership continue to govern attention.

beats.voice: Danish textile memory predates the contemporary week: Designmuseum Danmark describes thousands of fashion and textile objects, including historic costume and Danish design. That earlier record fixes a point in time; it does not prove an inevitable progression toward the present.
